text:
Container for the references to IdsMEvent elements representing the
security events that the CanIf module shall report to the IdsM in case
the coresponding security related event occurs (and if
CanIfEnableSecurityEventReporting is set to "true"). The standardized
security events in this container can be extended by vendor-specific
security events.
Tags:
atp.Status=draft

targets.why: enabling reporting security events to IdsM
